newsitem.title: MAURITANIA: Defence minister, five others sacked in Mauritania.
newsitem.headline: Defence minister, five others sacked in Mauritania.

text.p: Mauritania's President Maaouya Ould Sid'Ahmed Taya sacked his defence minister and five other cabinet members on Thursday in the first government shuffle following general elections earlier this month.
State radio said Defence Minister Abdallahi Ould Abdi had been replaced by Planning Minister Mohamed Ould Amar, whose place was taken by new appointee Ahmed Killy Ould Cheikh Sydia.
Other ministers fired were those for the civil service, culture, rural development, trade and water.
No reason was given for the changes.
